description: This file defines the CallableResolver class in Drupal, which provides methods to resolve various formats of PHP callables, including service notation, static methods, object methods, classes with __invoke, and closures. It interacts with a ClassResolverInterface to instantiate classes as needed.

classes.name: CallableResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves PHP callables from various definition formats, ensuring they are callable and providing appropriate exceptions when not.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a CallableResolver object with a ClassResolverInterface dependency.

methods.name: getCallableFromDefinition
methods.description: Resolves and returns a callable based on a provided definition, which can be a string, array, or callable. Throws exceptions if the definition is invalid or not callable.
